connector.name: agentic-pay
connector.registryDescription: Non-custodial payment engine for AI agents - BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, XRP, XMR, ZEC.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package agentic-pay. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the shieldcubed account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: AGENTIC_PAY_AGENT_ID
env.description: Identifier for this agent, used to look up its spend-limit policy in config.json.

env.name: AGENTIC_PAY_CONFIG
env.description: Absolute path to your config.json (spend limits, API keys, static prices). Defaults to config/config.json in the install directory.

env.name: BTC_WIF
env.description: WIF-encoded Bitcoin private key for the funding wallet. Only required if using the BTC rail.

env.name: ETH_RPC_URL
env.description: EVM JSON-RPC endpoint URL. Only required if using the ETH/USDT/USDC rails.

env.name: ETH_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: 0x-prefixed Ethereum private key for the funding wallet. Only required if using the ETH/USDT/USDC rails.
